title: Refresh inactive isolated status

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Inactive saved accounts must refresh through isolated saved-account app-server reads without mutating live local Codex auth.
Failed, missing, partial, zeroed, or suspicious inactive saved-account reads must preserve previous meaningful session and weekly rate-limit windows.

targetSurface: CodexPill inactive saved-account refresh use-case and app-server contract fixtures

nonClaims: Does not execute a live Codex app-server with real saved accounts.
Does not use real auth snapshots, tokens, account identifiers, emails, hostnames, or private paths.
Does not prove remote inactive-account refresh.
Does not prove menu projection or live macOS menu-bar behavior.
